propositions: Flaky (nondeterministic) test failures are bugs to root-cause and debug, not transient issues to be resolved by retrying CI until they pass.
The /rebar-debug workflow must be used to deterministically reproduce flaky tests before fixing the underlying class-level bug.
Recheck is only legitimate for provably environmental faults (TLS cert flakes, runner outages, missing CI dispatch) when stated reasoning is provided; it is never acceptable for test nondeterminism.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md previously contradicted each other by offering recheck as a remedy for failures that merely look transient, and must be reconciled to state the rule consistently.
A flaky CI pipeline slows development, wastes computational tokens, and erodes trust in CI as a regression oracle, justifying the investment in root-causing over retrying.
